content.text:
invoke-rc.d: policy-rc.d denied execution of restart.
Processing triggers for php8.1-cli (8.1.2-1ubuntu2.26) ...
curl
restarting php-fpm...
php8.1-fpm.pid
php8.1-fpm.sock

observation.command: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq php8.1-curl 2>&1 | tail -2; php -m | grep -i curl; echo "restarting php-fpm..."; kill $(cat /run/php/php8.1-fpm.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; /usr/sbin/php-fpm8.1 --daemonize --fpm-config /etc/php/8.1/fpm/php-fpm.conf; sleep 2; ls /run/php/
